If this is your first appointment and you cancel less than 24 hours before your appointment, there will be a $50 deposit required to schedule another appointment. This deposit will be applied toward your treatment if you arrive to your appointment on time. After three no-shows, you will be required to pay for the full cost of your service in advance when booking future appointments. Thank you for understanding. Book An Appointment
